sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
🧿 Triple Crystal Power Blend - Combines Tiger Eye, Pyrite, and Black Obsidian to support confidence, success mindset, and protection energy in one bracelet.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🐯 Boosts Confidence & Focus - Tiger Eye helps you stay grounded, make clearer decisions, and maintain a strong action-oriented mindset.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 💰 Attracts Growth & Stability - Pyrite is associated with abundance energy, motivation, and forward momentum in life.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🖤 Protection from Negative Energy - Black Obsidian supports emotional grounding and helps shield against unwanted external influences.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
-> Wear on your left hand to attract energy (wealth, opportunities). Wear on your right hand to project strength and confidence.

-> Best day to wear the bracelet is Thursday morning to align with growth, prosperity, confidence, and success energy.
-> Place the bracelet on a selenite plate for 4–6 hours or overnight. You can also keep it under moonlight (especially full moon) to refresh its energy. Recharge once every 7–10 days for best results.
-> Gently wipe with a soft dry cloth to remove dust and impurities. You can also cleanse energetically by placing it near incense or dhoop smoke for a few minutes. Drop the idea of using water or harsh chemicals.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Featuring a refined gold-toned chain, sparkling white CZ that gives a diamond-like feel, and three statement crystals, it delivers a truly premium and luxurious appeal. Each crystal brings its own unique energy, working together to create a perfect balance of protection, confidence, and abundance.

Brought to you by India’s biggest crystal home décor brand!

🔮 What Makes It Special

• 
Pyrite (The Wealth Magnet) - Known for attracting abundance, success, and confidence.

• 
Black Obsidian (The Protector) - A grounding crystal that helps shield against negativity.

• 
Tiger Eye (The Clarity Stone) - Supports focus, decision-making, and courage.

• 
White CZ Accents (Luxury Finish) - Elevates the bracelet into a premium statement piece.

✪ Note: Made using 100% true and tested crystals, ensuring each piece carries unique textures, natural variations, and authentic quality, supported by a rigorous multi-step quality testing process to ensure consistency, finish, and authenticity.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Can I wear this bracelet daily?

Yes, it is designed for everyday wear. Its lightweight feel and secure clasp make it comfortable and easy to style daily.

2. What benefits do these crystals offer?

Pyrite is known for attracting wealth and opportunities.

Tiger Eye supports confidence and clarity.

Black Tourmaline helps protect from negative energy and keeps you grounded.

3. Will the bracelet lose its shine over time?

With proper care, the premium finish and white CZ stones will maintain their shine and luxurious appeal for a long time.

4. Is the bracelet adjustable?

Yes, it comes with an extension chain so you can adjust it for a perfect and comfortable fit.

5. Can I gift this to someone?

Absolutely. Its elegant design and meaningful crystal combination make it a thoughtful and premium gifting choice.

6. Are the crystals real?

Yes, this bracelet is made using natural crystals. Each piece may have slight variations, adding to its uniqueness.

7. How should I take care of it?

Avoid contact with water, perfumes, and chemicals. Store it in a dry place to maintain its shine and finish.
